rule: The quote of an entry that was replied to. Years later: whole years between the two days, 0 for less than a year, for a reply earlier than the original, or for a day that does not exist. Excerpt: plain text on one line (white space collapsed), at most 120 characters, cut at a word boundary with an ellipsis; the mock strips Markdown only roughly, so the cases here have no markup. State: live, trash, or missing (the moved state is in reply-flow.json). A text may be written as a list of parts, where [unit, n] is the unit repeated n times.
mock: web/src/api/mockRules.ts replyQuote and yearsLater, web/src/api/mockText.ts plainSnippet
